title: imify doctor result
description: Written to stdout by `imify doctor --json`: the result of every check and the values the checks produced. A value is null when its check did not produce it.

platform.description: Operating system and CPU architecture the CLI was built for.

active_profile.description: The selected profile: `--profile`, else `IMIFY_PROFILE`, else `default`. Set also when the config file has no such profile. Null when the selected name is not a valid profile name.

api_url.description: The API URL the checks used.

api_url_source.description: Where the API URL comes from: the `--api-url` flag, the `IMIFY_API_URL` variable, the config file, or the built-in default.

api_url_profile.description: The profile whose table in the config file supplied the API URL, `default` for the top-level key, when `api_url_source` is `config`; otherwise null.

latency_ms.description: Duration of the `GET /api/health` request in milliseconds.

clock_skew_ms.description: The server's `Date` header minus the local time in milliseconds. The `Date` header has a resolution of 1 s.

readiness.description: The readiness document of the API.

status.description: `ok` when the API can serve every request.

token_source.description: Where the access token comes from: `env` for `IMIFY_TOKEN`, `stored` for the stored login of the host.

token_expires_at.description: The `exp` claim of the access token, RFC 3339 in UTC. For a stored login, the expiry of the stored ID token.

user.description: The user the access token belongs to.

credential_store.description: The credential store `IMIFY_CREDENTIAL_STORE` selects; null when its value is unsupported.

config_dir.description: The directory of `config.toml` and `credentials.json`; null when it cannot be located.

login.description: The stored login the token comes from; null unless `token_source` is `stored`.

storage.description: Where the login is stored, as in `imify auth login --json`.

has_refresh_token.description: `true` when the login can be refreshed.

oidc.description: The identity provider settings `imify auth login` uses.

checks.description: The checks in the order they are reported.

code.description: Error code of a failed check, as in error.json; null unless `status` is `fail`.

hint.description: What to do next; null when there is no hint.
